rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The Office of the President issued the 'Speech of President Thabo Mbeki at his inauguration as President of the Republic of South Africa: Union Buildings, Pretoria, 16 June 1999'. He describes the occasion as 'the solemn act of the inauguration of the President of our Republic' and refers to 'our outgoing President, Nelson Mandela'.

locator.section: Heading; body paragraphs 1, 5 and 6 after the salutation (beginning 'I am honoured', 'For us, as South Africans' and 'I speak of the generation'); closing 'Issued by the Office of the President,16 June 1999'
